items.title: 21.12 Fazai gardish aur fazai cells (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of atmospheric circulation and cells (PDF 181-182).

blocks.text: Angular momentum ka tahaffuz, zameen ke ghoomne ke saath, chalti hawa ke naqshe banane mein ahem kirdar ada karta hai. Zameen ke mehwar ke gird hawa ke aik hisse ka angular momentum L = mvr hai, jahan m hawa ki kamiyat, r ghoomne ke mehwar se us ka faasla aur v us ki velocity hai. Fazai science mein aam taur par specific angular momentum, yani fi ikai kamiyat angular momentum, use hota hai: L = rv (21.6).

Jab hawa khat-e-istiwa se qutb ki taraf chalti hai to apna specific angular momentum barqarar rakhti hai. Mehwar se us ka faasla r ghatta hai, is liye rv constant rakhne ke liye us ki mashriq ki taraf raftar v barhti hai. Oonche arz-e-balad par neeche ki zameen mashriq ki taraf ahista chalti hai, is liye yeh hawa satah se tez mashriq ki taraf chalti hai: zameen se dekhne par yeh mashriq ki taraf murti hai, jo shimali nisf-kurrah mein daen taraf hai. Qutb se khat-e-istiwa ki taraf jati hawa ulat karti hai: yeh tez chalti zameen se peeche reh kar maghrib ki taraf murti hai, jo shimali nisf-kurrah mein phir us ki harkat ke daen hai. Zameen ke ghoomne se chalti hawa ka yeh zahiri mor Coriolis effect hai: shimali nisf-kurrah mein daen aur junoobi mein baen. Yeh hawa ki raftar nahi badalta balke us ka rasta badal kar mure hawa ke naqshe banata hai.

blocks.title: Qutb ki taraf jati hawa aage nikalti hai, peeche nahi
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke khat-e-istiwa se qutb ki taraf jati hawa 'neeche ki satah ke ghoomne se peeche reh jati hai'. Usi ki daleel se (r ghatta, is liye v barhta) qutb ki taraf jati hawa neeche ki zameen se tez mashriq ki taraf chalti hai, is liye aage nikal kar mashriq ki taraf murti hai; khat-e-istiwa ki taraf jati hawa peeche reh jati hai. Dono suraton mein shimali nisf-kurrah mein mor daen taraf hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen ka gola, beech mein khat-e-istiwa. Shimali nisf-kurrah mein qutb ki taraf aur khat-e-istiwa ki taraf chalti hawa ke teer daen taraf mur jate hain; junoobi nisf-kurrah mein baen taraf. Grey dashed teer seedha raasta, neele teer asal mura hua raasta. Oopar teer: zameen maghrib se mashriq ghoomti hai.
blocks.caption: Coriolis effect: shimal mein daen aur junoob mein baen taraf mor (hamara izafi khaaka; kitab mein yeh figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chalti hawa apni raftar nahi badalti, sirf us ka rukh murta hai. Shimali nisf-kurrah mein hawa jis taraf bhi chale, apni daen taraf murti hai; junoobi nisf-kurrah mein baen taraf. Isi se trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies tirchi chalti hain.

Yeh mure hawa ke bahao har nisf-kurrah mein teen alag fazai gardish ke cells banate hain: Hadley cell, Ferrel cell aur Polar cell (Fig 21.14). Hadley cell mein garam hawa khat-e-istiwa par uth kar oonchai par qutbon ki taraf behti aur 30 darje arz-e-balad ke qareeb baithti hai; Polar cell mein thandi hawa qutbon par baith kar 60 darje ke qareeb uthti hai; Ferrel cell in ke darmiyan hai. Satah ke qareeb Coriolis effect wapas aate bahao ko trade winds, westerlies aur polar easterlies mein badal deta hai.

blocks.alt: Globe par arz-e-balad 60, 30, 0, 30, 60 darje. Is ke gird dono taraf aur dono nisf-kurron mein teeron ke band chakkar: surkh teer satah ke qareeb aur uthti hawa, neele teer oonchai par aur baithti hawa. Labels: khat-e-istiwa par Hadley Cells, 30 aur 60 darje ke darmiyan Ferrel Cell (chaar baar), oopar neeche Polar Cell.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.14: zameen ki fazai gardish mein cells banne ka khaaka (kitab ki Figure 21.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Junoobi nisf-kurrah mein chalti hawa kis taraf murti hai, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Apni harkat ke baen taraf, zameen ke ghoomne ki wajah se (Coriolis effect, angular momentum ke tahaffuz se); shimali nisf-kurrah mein daen taraf murti hai.

items: Chalti hawa specific angular momentum L = rv barqarar rakhti.
Coriolis effect: daen (shimal) aur baen (junoob) mor; raftar wahi.
Har nisf-kurrah mein teen cells: Hadley (0-30), Ferrel (30-60), Polar (60-90).
